items.title: Anthropic launches Personal Finance in Claude with Plaid bank links
items.summary: Anthropic 為美國 Pro／Max／Ultra 用戶推出 Personal Finance beta：經 Plaid 唯讀連接銀行同信用卡，可問開支分類、結餘同帳單。公司稱金融 hub 對話唔會用嚟訓練模型，亦唔會代用戶轉帳或投資。

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber for aligned vulnerability research
items.summary: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Cyber：ExploitGym 由 GPT-5.6 Cyber 嘅 32.1% 升至 48.5%，並將網絡安全準備度評為 Critical。模型協助搵到 Firefox 81 個高嚴重未知漏洞，並喺 Daybreak Red 先向核准客戶開放。
items.note: Official OpenAI post dated Nov 5 2026; exact time-of-day not stated, noon HKT used as convention. Corroborated by The Verge.
items.imageAlt: OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber announcement social card

items.title: Google launches Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with 15-second video and 30% lower price
items.summary: Google DeepMind 推出並全面開放 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash：原生影片最長 15 秒、支援多輪對話式剪輯同更強參考一致性；720p 定價降至每秒 $0.07（較 1.1 平約 30%），經 Gemini API 同 Google Cloud 提供。
items.note: Google blog dated Nov 5 2026; time-of-day unknown.
items.imageAlt: Google Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash announcement

items.title: Meta rolls out Muse Voice and expressive avatars to all US users
items.summary: Meta 喺美國全面開放 Muse Voice：可喺手機、網頁同 Mac 用語音／視像同 Muse 即時對話，虛擬形象會配合語氣做表情同手勢。公司稱之後會延伸到 AI Glasses 同即將推出嘅 Muse Charm。
items.note: Meta Newsroom Nov 5 2026; TechCrunch corroborates US-wide rollout same day.
items.imageAlt: Meta Muse Voice and expressive avatars social share

items.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore adds Web Answer for cited web answers in one call

items.note: AWS What's New dated Nov 5 2026; page lacked a usable article og:image.

items.title: Anthropic studies 207,000 research sessions on how scientists use Claude

items.note: Anthropic research post published Nov 5 2026; time-of-day unknown.
items.imageAlt: Anthropic research on how scientists use Claude

items.title: NVIDIA open-weights four Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for interactive world simulation

items.imageAlt: NVIDIA Cosmos 3 interactive world simulation blog thumbnail

items.title: Sandflow open-sources Sand3D: 106,094 code-written 3D objects for LLMs

items.title: Tencent launches Hy4 flagship model; open weights planned in coming days
items.summary: 騰訊發布新一代 Hy4：首次加入視覺理解同 computer-use，並強化長程代理任務；官方稱表現躋身領先開源陣營，並將於數日內公開權重同 system card。API 已喺 TokenHub、OpenRouter 等可用，定價維持每百萬 input 約 US$0.90。

items.title: VeriSpoof open-weights audio LLM for deepfake forensics beyond real/fake

items.imageAlt: VeriSpoof audio forensics model blog image

items.title: Hong Kong police to add AI facial recognition to Sharp Eyes CCTV this month
items.summary: 港台報道警方「銳眼計劃」閉路電視系統將喺本月內加入 AI 人臉識別；稱考慮算力唔會同時啟用全部鏡頭，目標至 2028 年全港約 6 萬支鏡頭可用。警方案例包括尋回失智長者同偵查行劫，並指使用前須授權、督察級以上審批，影像儲存不多於 31 日、人臉數據不多於 180 日。
items.imageAlt: Hong Kong Sharp Eyes CCTV AI facial recognition news photo

items.title: SJ Paul Lam: DoJ advances AI risk governance and human-in-the-loop lawtech
items.summary: 律政司司長林定國喺香港法律科技周 LawTech Forum 開幕致辭，重申 Policy Address 2026 下 AI 風險管治七方面；部門跨局工作小組已初步覆核逾 600 條條例，優先處理 deepfake／網絡罪案、未成年人社交媒體同 AI、以及 AI 產品事故法律責任。強調「Human in the Loop」同專業誠信。
items.imageAlt: Secretary for Justice speaking at LawTech Forum

items.title: Longbridge AI and Cyberport sign three-year agentic AI partnership
items.summary: 長橋集團旗下 Longbridge AI 同數碼港簽署三年戰略合作，推動香港金融服務負責任 agentic AI；雙方會共建 Hong Kong AI Lab，並喺研究、業界交流同人才培育四方面協作。消息喺金融科技周期間公布。
items.imageAlt: Longbridge and Cyberport agentic AI partnership press image

items.title: HKICPA publishes AI and Data Governance practical guidance
items.summary: 香港會計師公會發布《人工智能與數據管治：市場觀察及實務指引》，檢視 124 家恒生綜合大型股年報：92 家明確用 AI、26 家未披露。公會提出五步「AI/GenAI 數據使用決策框架」，強調數據管治、控制措施同人類監督，並指企業多披露應用而少披露管治程序。
items.note: Official HKICPA news release dated 05 November 2026; clock time not stated on page, so T00:00:00+08:00 used. RTHK covered same day at HKT 17:15.

items.title: Monolith Soft confirms contract work on Ocarina of Time Switch 2 remake
items.summary: Xenoblade 開發商 Monolith Soft 宣布以部分承包形式參與《Zelda: Ocarina of Time》Switch 2 重製嘅遊戲設計、程式同圖像；主開發仍為任天堂 EPD Production Group No. 3。
items.note: Nintendo Life stamp 4:55am without TZ; treated as UK morning Nov 5 → ~12:55 HKT. Uncertain exact minute.
items.imageAlt: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 remake screenshot

items.title: Pillars of Eternity 1 and 2 PC controller-support public test goes live
items.summary: Obsidian 於 11 月 4 日開放《Pillars of Eternity》同《Deadfire》PC 手掣支援公開測試（Steam／GOG／Xbox PC），可全程手掣遊玩，Deadfire 回合制亦按一代改進重做；PC Gamer 於 11 月 5 日跟進。
items.note: Obsidian post dated November 4, 2026 (date-only). PC Gamer follow-up published 5 November 2026.
items.imageAlt: Pillars of Eternity controller support announcement art

items.title: Stellar Blade free Bayonetta crossover outfits live on PS5 and PC
items.summary: Shift Up 為 Stellar Blade 推出免費 Bayonetta 聯名造型更新，包含 Bayonetta、Jeanne、Nun 同原創 Black Tresses 等 Nanosuit；PS5／PC 玩家更新後即可喺 EVE 服裝清單拎。
items.note: Push Square relative '7 hours ago' at ~07:40 HKT Nov 6 → approx 00:40 HKT; mark uncertain on exact clock. Distinct from Switch 2 Complete Edition story.
items.imageAlt: Stellar Blade Bayonetta crossover outfits

items.title: Rockstar drops 37 new Grand Theft Auto 6 screenshots ahead of PS5 launch
items.summary: 距離 GTA 6 11 月 19 日發售剩兩週，Rockstar 再公開約 37 張新截圖，重點展示 Jason、Lucia 同 Vice City／Leonida 夜生活場面；PS5 預載仍定 11 月 10 日開始。
items.note: Push Square relative '8 hours ago' at ~07:40 HKT Nov 6 → approx 23:40 HKT Nov 5. Distinct from pre-download / pre-order sales stories.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto 6 screenshot batch preview

items.title: Yomawari: The Long Night Collection and Lost in the Dark out on PS5 in the west
items.summary: NIS America 確認恐怖系列 Yomawari: The Long Night Collection（含 Night Alone／Midnight Shadows）同 Yomawari: Lost in the Dark 已喺西方 PS5 上架，日本較早前已出過 PS5 版。
items.note: RPG Site datePublished 2026-11-05T15:20:00Z → 23:20 HKT. ANN press release same day.
items.imageAlt: Yomawari PS5 western launch artwork

items.title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite and MySims Cozy Bundle join Xbox Game Pass
items.summary: 11 月 5 日 Game Pass 再加三作：消防模擬 Firefighting Simulator: Ignite、MySims Cozy Bundle，以及已經預告過嘅 Escape Academy 2；Ignite 支援 Ultimate/Premium/PC，MySims 亦上到主機同雲端。
items.note: Pure Xbox '11am' treated as UK → 19:00 HKT. Day-of availability update; Escape Academy 2 wave already covered—lead is Ignite/MySims. Official dates also on Xbox Wire Nov 3 wave post.
items.imageAlt: Xbox Game Pass November 5 additions artwork

items.title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla Most Requested Update adds New Game+ and PS5 Pro PSSR
items.summary: Ubisoft 今日為 Assassin's Creed Valhalla 推出免費「Most Requested Update」，正式加入 New Game+、進階成長模式同符文系統強化；PS5 Pro 亦獲升級版 PSSR，Qualty 模式可更穩跑 4K/60。
items.note: PS Blog dated Nov 5 only (no clock) → T00:00:00+08:00. Also covered on Xbox Wire same day for Series/One.
items.imageAlt: Assassin's Creed Valhalla Most Requested Update artwork

items.title: Xbox Free Play Days: PAYDAY 3, Anno 117, BALL x PIT and more through Nov 8
items.summary: Xbox 新一輪 Free Play Days 由 11 月 5 日開到 8 日；Game Pass 會員可試 PAYDAY 3、BALL x PIT、Deceive Inc、Age of Wonders 4 等，Anno 117 同 Crime Boss 更係全 Xbox 玩家免費試玩。
items.note: Xbox Wire dated Nov 5; distinct from late-Oct Free Play Days already in skip list.
items.imageAlt: Xbox Free Play Days November 5–8 promotional art

items.title: The End of the Sun launches on Xbox Series X|S with Slavic folklore adventure
items.summary: 波蘭工作室 The End of the Sun Forge 嘅第一人稱冒險作 The End of the Sun 已登陸 Xbox Series；故事受斯拉夫民間傳說啟發，大量場景物件用博物館實物 photogrammetry 掃描還原。
items.note: Xbox Wire dated Nov 4; publisher IMGN.PRO also posted out-now notice same day.
items.imageAlt: The End of the Sun Xbox launch key art

items.title: Take-Two's Strauss Zelnick: GTA 6 was expensive and delays were the right call
items.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick 接受 WSJ 訪問時承認 GTA 6「好貴、又花好耐時間」，但堅持延期係正確決定；佢亦暗指有公司為趕檔期而推出最終要下架嘅高調作品。
items.note: GameSpot Nov 5, 6:13AM PST → 22:13 HKT. Based on WSJ interview.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto 6 Lucia Caminos

items.title: Sony: PlayStation 6 development progressing as scheduled; PS5 sales hit 97.9m
items.summary: Sony 財報指 PS5 累計售出 9790 萬部（季內 260 萬），CFO 稱下一代主機開發「按計劃推進」，下個財年會有實質投入；同時上調遊戲業務展望，Marvel's Wolverine 銷量逾 240 萬。
items.note: VGC '5th Nov 2026 / 8:19 am' treated as UK GMT → 16:19 HKT. Wolverine 2.4m / forecast raise also on IGN Nov 5.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation hardware anniversary display

items.title: Sensor Tower: GTA 6 nears 7.71m pre-orders and $751m before launch
items.summary: Sensor Tower 估計 GTA 6 發售前數位預購約 771 萬套、收入約 7.51 億美元，其中 PS5 佔約 74%、Xbox Series 約 26%；遊戲 11 月 19 日先上主機。
items.note: Polygon published Nov 4, 1:31 PM EST → 2026-11-05T02:31:00+08:00. Third-party estimate, not Rockstar official.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto 6 Lucia and Jason artwork

items.title: Xbox rolls out faster PC app and refreshed web/cloud gaming experience
items.summary: Xbox 宣佈 Insider 可試用加速版 PC App（啟動最快約快 60%），同時把刷新過嘅網頁／雲遊戲介面逐步開放畀更多玩家，並開始推到支援電視同 VR 頭顯嘅雲遊戲 App。
items.note: Xbox Wire dated Nov 5 only → T00:00:00+08:00. PC/web/cloud UX story filed under other (not console hardware).
items.imageAlt: Xbox PC and cloud experience refresh header

items.title: Epic's Tim Sweeney doubles down on AI workflows for Unreal Engine 6
items.summary: 喺 Unreal Fest Tokyo，Tim Sweeney 強調 AI 工具趨勢「唔會走回頭」，Epic 會喺 Unreal Engine 6（預計 2027）全力導入 AI 工作流，並計劃以 AI 輔助遷移取代 Blueprints 等舊系統。
items.note: Kotaku dated Nov 5; Sweeney later clarified wording on X (update 9:54 p.m. ET). Industry/tools story.
items.imageAlt: Unreal Engine 6 logo
